# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform reliability and m156**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 improves platform support and native reliability while incorporating the latest Skia m156 fixes. This release updates Apple and Uno support, strengthens Linux and WebAssembly native packaging, and fixes stream, string, image-copy, and Android rendering behavior.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m156 fixes incorporated** — The bundled renderer includes the current upstream Chrome m156 bug-fix syncs. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **String and native data conversion hardened** — StringUtilities now validates Unicode character codes and string inputs correctly, while native C-string conversion avoids reading past its source buffer and writes directly to SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429), [#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Stream and image-copy behavior corrected** — Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily, and managed image pixel copies avoid avoidable overhead. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Texture rendering is synchronized with display refresh to improve Android presentation behavior. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Feature parsing avoids native allocations** — HarfBuzz feature-string handling no longer allocates native memory while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding uses pooled buffers** — HarfBuzzSharp reuses encoding buffers to reduce allocation pressure when processing UTF-32 text. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060))

## Platform

- **Uno WinUI support updated for Uno Platform 7** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI now builds against Uno Platform 7. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Native assets aligned across Apple, Windows, Linux, and WebAssembly** — Apple deployment targets and Windows dependencies align with current .NET platform requirements; Linux binds bundled HarfBuzz locally, and WebAssembly packages the required WebGPU implementation in libSkiaSharp. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
